name: cement_pairs_v1
author: claude-4.6-opus-agent-3
thesis: Indian cement companies (UltraTech, Shree Cement, Ambuja Cements, ACC, Dalmia Bharat) are operationally similar: same raw materials (limestone, coal/petcoke), similar pricing dynamics (cartelized regional pricing), identical regulatory framework, and shared demand drivers (government infra spending, housing). The group exhibits 0.55-0.70 daily correlation. Post the Adani acquisition of Ambuja Cements and ACC (2022), the correlation structure shifted but remained high within the non-Adani cement sub-group (UltraTech-Shree). The pairs trade exploits temporary divergences caused by: (1) regional demand variations (east vs south vs north) that create stock-specific moves within the sector, (2) quarterly volume/pricing data releases that affect one company before others report, (3) input cost changes (coal price) affecting different companies with different fuel mixes.
universe: UltraTech Cement, Shree Cement, Ambuja Cements, ACC, Dalmia Bharat
stock_filter: UltraTech: ADV > ₹80 crore. Shree Cement: ADV > ₹30 crore. Others: ADV > ₹20 crore

indicators.name: adani_cement_beta
indicators.formula: rolling_beta(Ambuja_return, ACC_return, 60) — Ambuja-ACC pair (now under same ownership)

conditions: cement_group_return not flat (sector must be moving for group signal to be relevant)
no stock-specific news (capacity addition, pricing change, acquisition)

filters.time_filter: no trades first 15 min or last 15 min
filters.volume_filter: divergent stock volume > 50th percentile of typical
filters.trend_filter: no filter (relative value trade is trend-independent)
filters.event_filter: skip on result days, CCI investigation days, cement price hike announcements
other_filters: skip Ambuja-ACC pair separately (now same ownership, trade as single entity)

edge.edge_decay_risk: Low — cement industry homogeneity is structural. Unless significant diversification occurs (e.g., cement companies entering new businesses), the correlation persists.

weaknesses: Cement stocks have moderate liquidity — Shree Cement and Dalmia Bharat can have wide intraday spreads (8-15 bps), significantly eroding the 20 bps edge.

Post-Adani acquisition of Ambuja+ACC, the 5-stock group is really two sub-groups: Adani cement (Ambuja, ACC) and independent (UltraTech, Shree, Dalmia). Cross-subgroup pairs may have lower correlation.
Cement is a cyclical sector sensitive to monsoon season (Jun-Sep) when construction activity drops. Intraday patterns may differ during monsoon vs non-monsoon.
prior_art: Gatev et al. (2006) for pairs trading framework. In India, cement sector correlation is well-documented in ICICI Direct and HDFC Securities sector reports. CCI (Competition Commission of India) investigations into cement cartelization confirm pricing linkage.
notes: Post-Adani acquisition, treat Ambuja+ACC as a single entity when computing group averages (use their combined weighted return as one input). The best pair for intraday is UltraTech-Shree Cement (similar market cap, both independently owned, highest correlation at 0.60-0.70).
